blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The Story Behind Our Brand

blocks_element.text: A hand holding sea moss and adding a spoonful of gel to a blender with frozen fruits.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In February 2014, Vegan Lifemoss founder
blocks_element.text: In February 2014, Vegan Lifemoss founder AJ had a stroke in his 30s. He spent two weeks in ICU and about two months in the hospital. He had to learn to walk again.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · After returning home, he wanted to under
blocks_element.text: After returning home, he wanted to understand more about his food, his habits, and the herbs people had used for generations. Starting with guidance from his brother's herbalist, he spent years reading, researching, and trying herbs to build his own routine.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In 2020, his Instagram followers began a
blocks_element.text: In 2020, his Instagram followers began asking to buy the herbs he shared. He started with separate herb bags, then brought the blend into vegan capsules to make the routine easier to take. That became Vegan Lifemoss—with a simple goal: make traditional herbal routines easier for people to use every day.
